entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manius Acilius Glabrio Gnaeus Cornelius Severus was a senator of the Roman Empire. He was consul ordinarius in 152 with Marcus Valerius Homullus as his colleague. Acilius Glabrio is known almost solely from surviving inscriptions.
